sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 751)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Wendell Corey & Shirley Mitchell in rookie detective domestic comedy on *McGarry and His Mouse* for Post's Raisin Bran, two sweeping romantic dramas on *Romance* (*Seventh Heaven* in 1945 and Bret Harte's *The Postmistress of Laurel Run* in 1954), Jean Arthur & Fred MacMurray in *Too Many Husbands* on *Globe Theater* for AFRS, Robert Montgomery exploring the historic French military espionage conspiracy in *The Dreyfus Affair* on *Intrigue*, and Elmer Davis on *CBS News*, Wendell Corey (1946), Austin Strong / Bret Harte (1945, 1954), Jean Arthur (1944), Robert Montgomery (1946), and Elmer Davis (1940–1954):
